close_reason: Decision C constrained (rename only the two misnomers + deprecated aliases). pkix-lint 0.6.0: rfc_section_id -> spec_section_id, rfc_url -> spec_url, with #[deprecated] default-impl aliases for one minor. Soften all six methods' doc comments to drop OSCAL-centric framing. Names title/description/parameters/set_parameter stay (already neutral). Applied under PKIX-ncab.11.
description:
PKIX-9vnx.6.1 added 4 default-provided methods to the `Lint` trait declaring per-lint metadata (id, title, description, parameters) that map to OSCAL Control fields. The metadata is useful regardless of OSCAL status, but the names/framing assume OSCAL.

Decide:

- **A) Rename** methods to drop "Control" naming (e.g., `lint_id`, `lint_title`, `lint_description`, `lint_parameters`). Breaking API change; pkix-lint 0.6.0.
- **B) Keep names**; update doc comments to soften OSCAL framing (non-breaking).
- **C) Both**: rename in 0.6.0 AND ship deprecated aliases for one minor version.

Downstream: .11 applies decision.

Decision-gate bead. Human label inherited from parent.
title: Decide fate of Lint trait OSCAL-Control metadata methods
